dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: There was a time when all I wanted was to learn everything there was to know. Explore every corner of the universe, witness all kinds of strange creatures and natural phenomena.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: And although that desire is long gone, the sight of this carefully curated collection does make me a little nostalgic.

dialogues.speaker: Skirk
dialogues.text: Perhaps I should meditate here... Might be more soothing for both my mind and body.
